title: Partial refund of a ten-ticket block

turns.user: I bought a block of ten paper single tickets and used two of them.
turns.agent:
Thanks—that means the block is partly used. If you’re asking about a refund, the 5 November 2026 snapshot says BKK’s ordinary refund requires all ten paper single tickets to be unused and consecutively numbered, so a partly used block isn’t eligible for an ordinary partial or pro-rata refund. A separate exchange window that applied only during June–August 2026 has ended.

I can’t process or confirm a refund or exchange. For the applicable current conditions, see BKK’s Product replacement and refund page. If you meant a different question about the tickets, tell me what you’d like to know.

turns.user: Could I return the remaining eight and get 80% of the price back?
turns.agent:
No—not under BKK’s ordinary refund rule in the 5 November 2026 snapshot. Because you used two tickets, the block is partly used; the snapshot says a paper block of ten must be unused in full and consecutively numbered for an ordinary refund. It does not support a refund of 80% for the eight remaining tickets. The special partial-block exchange window was only June–August 2026 and has ended.

For current terms, check BKK’s Product replacement and refund page. I can explain the rule, but I can’t process or confirm a refund.
